title: The Lock Call: Pilot
blurb: Leslie and Brett open the window, the president benches his own vice president, and Edwin is told to sit down.

title: The Lock Call: Monday, November 23
blurb: Brett and Merv take opposite sides of Akron and Wright State, the president finds someone to blame for the stock market, and Edwin tries the same excuse.

title: Lock Call Bonus: The Rocket Ship
blurb: Matthew on the day a president un-fired a CEO, with the gang cutting in.

title: The Lock Call: Tuesday, November 24
blurb: Brett and Merv took opposite sides and nobody lost, the president grades his own card, and Edwin starts a list.

title: The Lock Call: Wednesday, November 25
blurb: Merv takes the top of the board from Leslie, a turkey runs for the bushes and gets pardoned anyway, and Edwin asks where to apply.

title: The Lock Call: Thursday, November 26
blurb: Thanksgiving gas is $3.56, Merv grades the president's under-two-dollars ticket, and Brett and Edwin take opposite sides in San Antonio.

title: Lock Call Bonus: Thanksgiving Drama on the Bricks
blurb: The gang hosts Thanksgiving at The Window. The boss explains the whole operation, cannot stop looking at Mateo, and somebody barges in before dessert.

title: The Lock Call: Friday, November 27
blurb: The Farm Bureau prices Thanksgiving dinner at $58.63, Brett catches Merv at the top of the board, and Edwin blames an organ player.

title: The Lock Call: Saturday, November 28
blurb: The Big Mid debuts with Towson at Penn and Saint Joseph's at Monmouth, Wichita State beats Kentucky in overtime, and a planning commission books New Year's Eve for a golf course.
